title: Integrations
description: Explore Slang AI integrations with OpenTable, SevenRooms, Tripleseat, and more, so guests can book, change, and plan events over the phone around the clock.
blocks: Slang AI has teamed up with industry titans to deliver integrations that make it easier than ever for your guests to make reservations over the phone, around-the-clock, even when your staff is asleep.
Empower guests to book, modify, and cancel OpenTable reservations and surface OpenTable Experiences.
Capture and enrich every lead and automatically send them to Tripleseat.
Enable guests to book SevenRooms reservations directly over the phone.
Capture and enrich every lead and automatically send them to Perfect Venue.
Empower guests to make Yelp reservations over the phone.
